title: sony-bravia-linux: a right-to-repair revival of pre-Android Sony BRAVIA TVs
description: A right-to-repair revival of pre-Android Sony BRAVIA TVs (KDL EX7xx and HX8xx, 2011-12): an owner-run media stack, and the 3D fix, the missing H.264 frame-packing SEI that makes 3D files play flat (merged in HandBrake). Tools for side-by-side, MPO, JPS and anaglyph 3D photos and video, and documentation in 11 languages. Code under GPL-2.0-or-later; documentation, measurements and photographs under CC BY 4.0.
